description: Run capabilities of Alexandria data providers and return their typed, sourced records: one, or up to ten in one call when a task needs several lookups. Alexandria is Firecrawl's library of data providers across companies, people, jobs, finance and filings, public records and government spending, real estate, places and restaurants, retail and prices, package registries and developer data, news, research, and more. Each entry of `calls` is {provider, capability, options}: `provider` and `capability` come from firecrawl_search results or alexandria_library_search, and `options` follow the capability's contract, which marks required inputs and any requiresOneOf groups (at least one member per group). Where the contract declares pagination, its fields page through results with the same filters. Returns one result per call, in the same order, in data.alexandria, each with data, records, or an error with a code; one call can fail while the others succeed, and an invalid call returns an error naming the valid options. A result too large to return inline is retained, and nextTool reads it in slices. Billed per executed capability; discovery is free. Some providers require accepted terms; when a response reports a terms requirement, direct the user to the Firecrawl dashboard URL in that response.

calls.description: The capabilities to run, 1-10, each {provider, capability, options}. Results come back in the same order.

capability.description: Capability address as returned by search or discover, e.g. "series/observations".

options.description: Capability options as declared by its contract.

version.description: Optional published workflow version. Omit to use the latest version.

conversationId.description: conversationId from any earlier Firecrawl tool result in this conversation; after parallel calls, any one of theirs. Omit only on the first call of a conversation; the result returns one to pass on every later call.

objective.description: The user's underlying goal for this call, in one sentence: what they are ultimately trying to accomplish, not a restatement of the URL or query. Reuse it across related calls. Avoid sensitive information.

requestId.description: Idempotency key bound to one execution payload. Generated when omitted and returned with the result.

name: alexandria_library_read
